record.question: As per 339. (1) Any Magistrate inquiring into or trying a case may permit the prosecution to be conducted by any person other than a police officer below the _________; but no person, other than the Advocate-General or Government Advocate or a Public Prosecutor or Assistant Public Prosecutor, shall be entitled to do so without such permission:
record.explanation: BNSS Section 339 permits prosecution by persons other than police officers below inspector rank.
